featured_reviews.name: Fatema Patel
featured_reviews.review_text: HS Mart is more than just a stationery store—it’s a place where quality, passion, and trust truly come together. Every product is authentic, the collection is thoughtfully curated, and the guidance you receive makes a real difference. You can feel the care they put into what they do. featured_reviews.name: Kaveri Mahto
featured_reviews.review_text: Had visited HS Mart at Lil Flea and was honestly blown away. The collection was outstanding, with some of the best stationery and art products I’ve seen. Everything was genuine, thoughtfully displayed.

featured_reviews.name: Divya
featured_reviews.review_text:
Situated in Abdul Rehman Street this place is a bit difficult to find due to it's location. Also, it's located on the first floor.

Honestly, this place is like being in heaven for artists and art lovers alike. It has got all possible brands and all possible things that an artist needs and wants. The only problem that I found is that it is way too expensive.

Situated in Abdul Rehman, you would get the same products at the lowest price possible in nearby shops. No doubt that the brands you get here are quite difficult to find nearby but, if you are not really a brand specific shopper I would suggest you to walk down the street and you will get the exact same product at dirt cheap prices.

Also a thing that was a bit off-putting was the service provided. It felt like the staff was forced to help and showed the least amount of interest.

featured_reviews.name: Aride Services
featured_reviews.review_text: Arrogant, Rude and Unproffesional staff @zaveri bazaar branch. Being the oldest customer visiting this only branch for every small or big purchase I appreciate the respect we use to receive as a customer during those day's.  But now a day's their sales staff have become so lazy and disrespectful. They rush towards only big purchase customer by completely ignoring small requirements of customer immediately replying by saying 'madam me  busy hu aapko baad me batati hu' both in gold and especially in diamond department i think the diamond department is not interested in selling light weight jewellary and to low budget shopping customers for regular use. Greeting with water, tea n coffee use to be their tradition but now as a customer we have to run behind them. Their main problem is whenever they see a customer they start aiming for higher purchase from us every time when we visit  otherwise they start showing 'I don't care' kind of attitude ' Take only whatever is available' without giving an effort to provide us different options they might have to meet our requirements They on the spot takes their own decision and declares it impossible without taking advice from their seniors and then we forcibily have to call their high level staff to settle at our requirements for choices or any alterations if we wannt to make in the product and they immediately make it possible. The sales staff behaviour is very disappointing. Inshort shopping at tbz zaveri bazar is becoming very disappointing day by day.Today first time we had been to Santa Cruz branch and are very impressed with the way we got treated their though we didn't get the jewellery of our choice their as well but there was a vast different between the behaviour of staff of both branches. And we will be exploring other branches too.  I think all these sales staff of zaveri bazaar  needs  replacement by some proffessionals.
